label: Parallel printheads count
tooltip: Set the number of parallel printheads for machines like OrangeStorm Giga printer.

label: Support multi bed types
tooltip: Enable this option if you want to use multiple bed types.

label: Best object position
tooltip: Best auto arranging position in range [0,1] w.r.t. bed shape.

label: Z offset
tooltip: This value will be added (or subtracted) from all the Z coordinates in the output G-code. It is used to compensate for bad Z endstop position: for example, if your endstop zero actually leaves the nozzle 0.3mm far from the print bed, set this to -0.3 (or fix your endstop).

label: Preferred orientation
tooltip: Automatically orient STL files on the Z axis upon initial import.

label: Printer structure
tooltip: The physical arrangement and components of a printing device.

label: G-code flavor
tooltip: What kind of G-code the printer is compatible with.

label: Pellet Modded Printer
tooltip: Enable this option if your printer uses pellets instead of filaments.

label: Use 3rd-party print host
tooltip: Allow controlling BambuLab's printer through 3rd party print hosts.

label: Use 3MF instead of G-code
tooltip: Enable this if the printer accepts a 3MF file as the print job. When enabled, Orca Slicer sends the sliced file as a .gcode.3mf, instead of a plain .gcode file.

label: Scan first layer
tooltip: Enable this to enable the camera on printer to check the quality of first layer.

label: Power Loss Recovery
tooltip: Choose how to control power loss recovery. When set to Printer configuration, the slicer will not emit power loss recovery G-code and will leave the printer's configuration unchanged. Applicable to Bambu Lab or Marlin 2 firmware based printers.

label: Disable set remaining print time
tooltip: Disable generating of the M73: Set remaining print time in the final G-code.

label: G-code thumbnails
tooltip: Picture sizes to be stored into a .gcode and .sl1 / .sl1s files, in the following format: "XxY, XxY, ..."

label: Format of G-code thumbnails
tooltip: Format of G-code thumbnails: PNG for best quality, JPG for smallest size, QOI for low memory firmware.

label: Use relative E distances
tooltip: Relative extrusion is recommended when using "label_objects" option. Some extruders work better with this option unchecked (absolute extrusion mode). Wipe tower is only compatible with relative mode. It is recommended on most printers. Default is checked.

label: Use firmware retraction
tooltip: This experimental setting uses G10 and G11 commands to have the firmware handle the retraction. This is only supported in recent Marlin.

label: Time cost
tooltip: The printer cost per hour.

Start the fan this number of seconds earlier than its target start time (you can use fractional seconds). It assumes infinite acceleration for this time estimation, and will only take into account G1 and G0 moves (arc fitting is unsupported).
It won't move fan commands from custom G-code (they act as a sort of 'barrier').
It won't move fan commands into the start G-code if the 'only custom start G-code' is activated.
Use 0 to deactivate.

label: Only overhangs
tooltip: Will only take into account the delay for the cooling of overhangs.

label: Fan kick-start time
tooltip:
Emit a max fan speed command for this amount of seconds before reducing to target speed to kick-start the cooling fan.
This is useful for fans where a low PWM/power may be insufficient to get the fan started spinning from a stop, or to get the fan up to speed faster.
Set to 0 to deactivate.

label: Minimum non-zero part cooling fan speed
tooltip:
Some part-cooling fans cannot start spinning when commanded below a certain PWM duty cycle. When set above 0, any non-zero part-cooling fan command will be raised to at least this percentage so the fan reliably starts. A fan command of 0 (fan off) is always honoured exactly. This clamp is applied after every other fan calculation (first-layer ramp, layer-time interpolation, overhang/bridge/support-interface/ironing overrides), so scaling still operates within the range [this value, 100%].
If your firmware already disables the fan below a threshold (for example Klipper's [fan] off_below: 0.10 shuts the fan off whenever the commanded duty cycle is below 10%), this option and the firmware threshold should ideally be set to the same value. Matching them (e.g. off_below: 0.10 in Klipper and 10% here) guarantees the slicer never emits a non-zero value that the firmware would silently drop, and the fan never receives a value below the one you know it can actually spool at.
Set to 0 to deactivate.

label: Radius
tooltip: Clearance radius around extruder. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.

label: Height to rod
tooltip: Distance of the nozzle tip to the lower rod. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.

label: Height to lid
tooltip: Distance of the nozzle tip to the lid. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.

label: Bed mesh min
tooltip: This option sets the min point for the allowed bed mesh area. Due to the probe's XY offset, most printers are unable to probe the entire bed. To ensure the probe point does not go outside the bed area, the minimum and maximum points of the bed mesh should be set appropriately. OrcaSlicer ensures that adaptive_bed_mesh_min/adaptive_bed_mesh_max values do not exceed these min/max points. This information can usually be obtained from your printer manufacturer. The default setting is (-99999, -99999), which means there are no limits, thus allowing probing across the entire bed.

label: Bed mesh max
tooltip: This option sets the max point for the allowed bed mesh area. Due to the probe's XY offset, most printers are unable to probe the entire bed. To ensure the probe point does not go outside the bed area, the minimum and maximum points of the bed mesh should be set appropriately. OrcaSlicer ensures that adaptive_bed_mesh_min/adaptive_bed_mesh_max values do not exceed these min/max points. This information can usually be obtained from your printer manufacturer. The default setting is (99999, 99999), which means there are no limits, thus allowing probing across the entire bed.

label: Probe point distance
tooltip: This option sets the preferred distance between probe points (grid size) for the X and Y directions, with the default being 50mm for both X and Y.

label: Mesh margin
tooltip: This option determines the additional distance by which the adaptive bed mesh area should be expanded in the XY directions.

label: Nozzle HRC
tooltip: The nozzle's hardness. Zero means no checking for nozzle's hardness during slicing.

label: Auxiliary part cooling fan
tooltip: Enable this option if machine has auxiliary part cooling fan. G-code command: M106 P2 S(0-255).

label: Support control chamber temperature
tooltip:
This option is enabled if machine support controlling chamber temperature
G-code command: M141 S(0-255)

label: Support air filtration
tooltip:
Enable this if printer support air filtration
G-code command: M106 P3 S(0-255)

label: File header G-code
tooltip: G-code written at the very top of the output file, before any other content. Useful for adding metadata that printer firmware reads from the first lines of the file (e.g. estimated print time, filament usage). Supports placeholders like {print_time_sec} and {used_filament_length}.

label: Start G-code

default_value.value: G28 ; home all axes\nG1 Z5 F5000 ; lift nozzle\n

tooltip: Start G-code when starting the entire print.

label: End G-code

default_value.value:
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
G28 X0  ; home X axis
M84     ; disable motors

tooltip: End G-code when finishing the entire print.

label: Between Object G-code
tooltip: Insert G-code between objects. This parameter will only come into effect when you print your models object by object.

label: Before layer change G-code
tooltip: This G-code is inserted at every layer change before the Z lift.

label: Layer change G-code
tooltip: This G-code is inserted at every layer change after the Z lift.

label: Change filament G-code
tooltip: This G-code is inserted when filament is changed, including T commands to trigger tool change.

label: Change extrusion role G-code
tooltip: This G-code is inserted when the extrusion role is changed.

label: Pause G-code
tooltip: This G-code will be used as a code for the pause print. Users can insert pause G-code in the G-code viewer.

label: Custom G-code
tooltip: This G-code will be used as a custom code.

label: Printer notes
tooltip: You can put your notes regarding the printer here.

label: Emit limits to G-code
tooltip:
If enabled, the machine limits will be emitted to G-code file.
This option will be ignored if the G-code flavor is set to Klipper.

label: Resonance avoidance
tooltip:
By reducing the speed of the outer wall to avoid the resonance zone of the printer, ringing on the surface of the model are avoided.
Please turn this option off when testing ringing.

label: Min
tooltip: Minimum speed of resonance avoidance.

label: Max
tooltip: Maximum speed of resonance avoidance.

label: Emit input shaping
tooltip:
Override firmware input shaping settings.
If disabled, firmware settings are used.

label: Input shaper type
tooltip:
Choose the input shaper algorithm.
Default uses the firmware default settings.
Disable turns off input shaping in the firmware.

label: X
tooltip:
Resonant frequency for the X axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware frequency.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.
RRF: X and Y values are equal.

label: Y
tooltip:
Resonant frequency for the Y axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware frequency.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.

label: X
tooltip:
Damping ratio for the X axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware damping ratio.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.
RRF: X and Y values are equal.

label: Y
tooltip:
Damping ratio for the Y axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware damping ratio.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.

label: Maximum speed X
tooltip: Maximum speed of X axis

label: Maximum speed Y
tooltip: Maximum speed of Y axis

label: Maximum speed Z
tooltip: Maximum speed of Z axis

label: Maximum speed E
tooltip: Maximum speed of E axis

label: Maximum acceleration X
tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the X axis

label: Maximum acceleration Y
tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the Y axis

label: Maximum acceleration Z
tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the Z axis

label: Maximum acceleration E
tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the E axis

label: Maximum acceleration for extruding
tooltip: Maximum acceleration for extruding (M204 P)

label: Maximum acceleration for retracting
tooltip: Maximum acceleration for retracting (M204 R)

label: Maximum acceleration for travel
tooltip: Maximum acceleration for travel (M204 T), it only applies to Marlin 2.

label: Maximum Junction Deviation
tooltip:
Maximum junction deviation (M205 J, only apply if JD > 0 for Marlin Firmware
If your Marlin 2 printer uses Classic Jerk set this value to 0.)

label: Maximum jerk X
tooltip: Maximum jerk of the X axis

label: Maximum jerk Y
tooltip: Maximum jerk of the Y axis

label: Maximum jerk Z
tooltip: Maximum jerk of the Z axis

label: Maximum jerk E
tooltip: Maximum jerk of the E axis

label: Minimum speed for extruding
tooltip: Minimum speed for extruding (M205 S)

label: Minimum travel speed
tooltip: Minimum travel speed (M205 T)

label: Single Extruder Multi Material
tooltip: Use single nozzle to print multi filament.

label: Manual Filament Change
tooltip: Enable this option to omit the custom Change filament G-code only at the beginning of the print. The tool change command (e.g., T0) will be skipped throughout the entire print. This is useful for manual multi-material printing, where we use M600/PAUSE to trigger the manual filament change action.

label: Bed temperature type
tooltip: This option determines how the bed temperature is set during slicing: based on the temperature of the first filament or the highest temperature of the printed filaments.

label: Wipe tower type
tooltip: Choose the wipe tower implementation for multi-material prints. Type 1 is recommended for Bambu and Qidi printers with a filament cutter. Type 2 offers better compatibility with multi-tool and MMU printers and provide overall better compatibility.

label: Purge in prime tower
tooltip: Purge remaining filament into prime tower.

label: Enable filament ramming
tooltip: Enable filament ramming

label: Tool change on wipe tower
tooltip: Force the toolhead to travel to the wipe tower before issuing the tool change command (Tx). Only relevant for multi-extruder (multi-toolhead) printers using a Type 2 wipe tower. By default Orca skips the travel on multi-toolhead machines because the firmware handles the head swap, which can result in the Tx command being issued above the printed part. Enable this option if you want the tool change to always be issued above the wipe tower instead.

label: Cooling tube position
tooltip: Distance of the center-point of the cooling tube from the extruder tip.

label: Cooling tube length
tooltip: Length of the cooling tube to limit space for cooling moves inside it.

label: Filament parking position
tooltip: Distance of the extruder tip from the position where the filament is parked when unloaded. This should match the value in printer firmware.

label: Extra loading distance
tooltip: When set to zero, the distance the filament is moved from parking position during load is exactly the same as it was moved back during unload. When positive, it is loaded further, if negative, the loading move is shorter than unloading.

label: High extruder current on filament swap
tooltip: It may be beneficial to increase the extruder motor current during the filament exchange sequence to allow for rapid ramming feed rates and to overcome resistance when loading a filament with an ugly shaped tip.

label: Filament load time
tooltip: Time to load new filament when switch filament. It's usually applicable for single-extruder multi-material machines. For tool changers or multi-tool machines, it's typically 0. For statistics only.

label: Filament unload time
tooltip: Time to unload old filament when switch filament. It's usually applicable for single-extruder multi-material machines. For tool changers or multi-tool machines, it's typically 0. For statistics only.

label: Tool change time
tooltip: Time taken to switch tools. It's usually applicable for tool changers or multi-tool machines. For single-extruder multi-material machines, it's typically 0. For statistics only.
